meanings.en: the state of the sky being covered with clouds
meanings.exampleEn: The cloudiness increased throughout the afternoon and it soon began to rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğleden sonra boyunca bulutluluk arttı ve kısa süre sonra yağmur yağmaya başladı.

meanings.en: lack of clearness or transparency in a liquid
meanings.exampleEn: The cloudiness of the water suggested it was contaminated.
meanings.exampleTr: Suyun bulanıklığı kirlenmiş olduğunu gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: having no knowledge or understanding of something
meanings.exampleEn: He was completely clueless about how to fix the computer.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilgisayarı nasıl tamir edeceği konusunda tamamen bilgisizdi.

meanings.en: a small group of things growing or gathered closely together
meanings.exampleEn: A clump of trees stood at the edge of the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarlanın kenarında bir ağaç kümesi vardı.

meanings.en: to walk with heavy steps making a dull sound
meanings.exampleEn: I heard him clump up the stairs in his boots.
meanings.exampleTr: Botlarıyla merdivenleri ağır adımlarla çıktığını duydum.

meanings.en: to hold something tightly, often out of fear or anxiety
meanings.exampleEn: She clutched her bag tightly as she walked through the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalığın içinden geçerken çantasını sıkıca tuttu.

meanings.en: the mechanism in a vehicle that connects the engine to the wheels
meanings.exampleEn: He pressed the clutch and shifted into first gear.
meanings.exampleTr: Debriyaja bastı ve birinci vitese geçti.

meanings.en: to become or make something rough, harsh, or less refined
meanings.exampleEn: Years of hard outdoor work had coarsened his hands.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren ağır açık hava işi ellerini sertleştirmişti.

meanings.en: a curved piece of wood, plastic, or wire for hanging clothes on
meanings.exampleEn: She hung her jacket on a wooden coat hanger in the wardrobe.
meanings.exampleTr: Ceketini gardıroptaki ahşap elbise askısına astı.

meanings.en: to treat someone with excessive care and protection
meanings.exampleEn: His parents coddled him so much that he never learned to be independent.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesi onu o kadar şımarttı ki bağımsız olmayı hiç öğrenemedi.

meanings.en: to cook food, especially eggs, gently in water just below boiling point
meanings.exampleEn: She coddled the eggs in a bowl of warm water.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumurtaları bir kâse ılık suda hafifçe pişirdi.

meanings.en: united and working together effectively as a whole
meanings.exampleEn: The coach built a cohesive team that trusted one another.
meanings.exampleTr: Antrenör birbirine güvenen uyumlu bir takım kurdu.

meanings.en: a group of people sharing a common characteristic, especially in a study
meanings.exampleEn: The study followed a cohort of 500 patients over ten years.
meanings.exampleTr: Araştırma, 500 hastadan oluşan bir grubu on yıl boyunca izledi.

meanings.en: a companion or associate
meanings.exampleEn: He arrived at the party with his usual cohort of friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Partiye her zamanki arkadaş grubuyla geldi.

meanings.en: shared or done by all members of a group together
meanings.exampleEn: The decision was a collective one, made by the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar, tüm ekip tarafından alınan ortak bir karardı.

meanings.en: a business or organization owned and run jointly by its members
meanings.exampleEn: The farmers formed a collective to sell their produce.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçiler ürünlerini satmak için bir kooperatif kurdu.

meanings.en: as a group; by everyone together rather than individually
meanings.exampleEn: The staff collectively agreed to the new working hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışanlar yeni mesai saatlerini toplu olarak kabul etti.

meanings.en: extremely large in size or amount
meanings.exampleEn: The project required a colossal amount of money and effort.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje muazzam miktarda para ve çaba gerektirdi.

meanings.en: having many bright colours
meanings.exampleEn: The market was full of colourful fruit and vegetables.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazar rengârenk meyve ve sebzelerle doluydu.

meanings.en: lively, interesting, and full of variety
meanings.exampleEn: She told colourful stories about her travels abroad.
meanings.exampleTr: Yurt dışı seyahatleri hakkında ilgi çekici hikâyeler anlattı.

meanings.en: returning to a place or state
meanings.exampleEn: I'll be coming back home next week after the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezinin ardından önümüzdeki hafta eve geri döneceğim.

meanings.tr: yeniden popüler olmak, geri dönmek (moda vb.)
meanings.en: becoming popular or fashionable again
meanings.exampleEn: Vinyl records are coming back in a big way.
meanings.exampleTr: Plaklar büyük bir şekilde yeniden popüler oluyor.

meanings.en: the officer in charge of a military unit
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers saluted their commanding officer as he entered.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler içeri giren birlik komutanını selamladı.

meanings.en: a person who describes and comments on an event, especially on TV or radio
meanings.exampleEn: The football commentator grew excited as the final goal was scored.
meanings.exampleTr: Son gol atılırken futbol spikeri heyecanlandı.

meanings.en: a person who writes or speaks expert opinions on a subject
meanings.exampleEn: A political commentator analysed the results of the election.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir siyasi yorumcu seçim sonuçlarını değerlendirdi.

meanings.en: loyal and willing to give your time and energy to something you believe in
meanings.exampleEn: She is a committed teacher who stays late to help her students.
meanings.exampleTr: O, öğrencilerine yardım etmek için geç saatlere kalan, kendini işine adamış bir öğretmendir.

meanings.en: the quality of being frequent, ordinary, or widely found
meanings.exampleEn: The commonness of the name made him hard to trace.
meanings.exampleTr: İsmin yaygınlığı onu bulmayı zorlaştırdı.

meanings.tr: banliyö kuşağı (şehre çalışmaya gidenlerin yaşadığı çevre bölge)
meanings.en: the area around a city where people live and travel into the city to work
meanings.exampleEn: House prices in the commuter belt around London have risen sharply.
meanings.exampleTr: Londra çevresindeki banliyö kuşağında ev fiyatları hızla yükseldi.

meanings.en: a separate section within a container or space
meanings.exampleEn: She kept her passport in a hidden compartment of her bag.
meanings.exampleTr: Pasaportunu çantasının gizli bir bölmesinde tuttu.

meanings.en: a separate enclosed section of a railway carriage
meanings.exampleEn: We had a whole train compartment to ourselves.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün bir tren kompartımanı bize aitti.

meanings.en: forced or strongly obliged to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She felt compelled to apologise for her rude behaviour.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaba davranışı için özür dilemek zorunda hissetti kendini.

meanings.tr: rehavete kapılmış, kendini fazla güvende hisseden
meanings.en: feeling so satisfied with yourself that you stop making an effort
meanings.exampleEn: After early success, the company became complacent and lost customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Erken başarının ardından şirket rehavete kapıldı ve müşteri kaybetti.

meanings.en: a strong, often uncontrollable urge to do something
meanings.exampleEn: He felt a compulsion to check the door lock several times.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapı kilidini birkaç kez kontrol etmek için karşı konulamaz bir dürtü hissetti.

meanings.en: the act of forcing someone to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She signed the contract under compulsion, not by choice.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmeyi kendi isteğiyle değil, zorlama altında imzaladı.

meanings.en: to convert a system or process to be controlled or done by computer
meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to computerize its entire accounting system.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket tüm muhasebe sistemini bilgisayarlaştırmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: about; on the subject of
meanings.exampleEn: I have a few questions concerning your recent report.
meanings.exampleTr: Son raporunuzla ilgili birkaç sorum var.

meanings.en: causing worry or anxiety
meanings.exampleEn: The rise in unemployment is deeply concerning.
meanings.exampleTr: İşsizlikteki artış son derece endişe verici.

meanings.en: a hotel employee who helps guests with bookings, directions, and requests
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel concierge arranged a taxi to the airport for us.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel resepsiyon görevlisi bizim için havaalanına bir taksi ayarladı.

meanings.en: intended to make someone less angry and more willing to agree
meanings.exampleEn: He made a conciliatory gesture by apologising first.
meanings.exampleTr: Önce özür dileyerek uzlaştırıcı bir jest yaptı.

meanings.en: the quality of expressing something clearly in few words
meanings.exampleEn: The report was praised for its conciseness and clarity.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor özlülüğü ve netliği nedeniyle övgü aldı.

meanings.en: the expression of strong disapproval
meanings.exampleEn: The attack drew widespread condemnation from world leaders.
meanings.exampleTr: Saldırı, dünya liderlerinden geniş çapta kınama aldı.

meanings.en: in a way that depends on certain conditions being met
meanings.exampleEn: The loan was approved conditionally, pending further documents.
meanings.exampleTr: Kredi, ek belgeler beklenmek üzere koşullu olarak onaylandı.

meanings.en: to express sympathy for someone who is grieving or in trouble
meanings.exampleEn: Friends gathered to condole with the family after their loss.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşlar, kayıplarının ardından aileye başsağlığı dilemek için toplandı.

meanings.en: sweets, chocolates, and other sweet foods collectively
meanings.exampleEn: The shop sells a wide range of confectionery and chocolates.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkân geniş bir yelpazede şekerleme ve çikolata satıyor.

meanings.en: an alliance of states, groups, or organizations that unite for a common purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The states formed a confederation to defend against invasion.
meanings.exampleTr: Devletler, işgale karşı savunma amacıyla bir konfederasyon kurdu.

meanings.en: a person you trust and share your private feelings or secrets with
meanings.exampleEn: Her older sister was her closest confidant.
meanings.exampleTr: Ablası, onun en yakın sırdaşıydı.

meanings.tr: sırrını açmak, içini dökmek, güvenip anlatmak
meanings.en: to tell someone about a secret or private matter, trusting them not to repeat it
meanings.exampleEn: She confided in her best friend about her fears.
meanings.exampleTr: Korkularını en yakın arkadaşına açtı.

meanings.en: the state of keeping information secret or private
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors must respect the confidentiality of their patients.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar hastalarının gizliliğine saygı göstermek zorundadır.

meanings.en: in a trusting way, as if sharing a secret
meanings.exampleEn: She leaned over and whispered confidingly in my ear.
meanings.exampleTr: Bana doğru eğildi ve kulağıma güvenle bir şeyler fısıldadı.

meanings.en: the state of being kept in a restricted or enclosed space
meanings.exampleEn: The prisoner spent a month in solitary confinement.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkûm bir ayını hücre hapsinde geçirdi.

meanings.en: a large and destructive fire
meanings.exampleEn: The entire warehouse was destroyed in the conflagration.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün depo büyük yangında yok oldu.

meanings.tr: birbirine karıştırmak, birleştirmek (iki şeyi tek sanmak)
meanings.en: to combine two or more ideas or things into one, often mistakenly
meanings.exampleEn: People often conflate wealth with happiness.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar sıklıkla zenginlik ile mutluluğu birbirine karıştırır.

meanings.en: to behave according to accepted rules, standards, or expectations
meanings.exampleEn: All new buildings must conform to safety regulations.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm yeni binalar güvenlik yönetmeliklerine uymak zorundadır.

meanings.en: a hostile or angry meeting or disagreement between opposing sides
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to avoid a confrontation with his angry neighbour.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkeli komşusuyla bir çatışmadan kaçınmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: to change from a liquid to a thick, solid state, especially when cooling
meanings.exampleEn: The gravy had congealed on the cold plate.
meanings.exampleTr: Sos soğuk tabakta pıhtılaşıp katılaşmıştı.

meanings.tr: hoş, cana yakın, uyumlu (kişi veya ortam)
meanings.en: pleasant and agreeable because suited to your taste or nature
meanings.exampleEn: They found the small town a congenial place to raise their children.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük kasabayı çocuklarını yetiştirmek için hoş bir yer buldular.

meanings.en: serving to connect or join things together
meanings.exampleEn: Connective tissue holds the muscles and organs in place.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağ dokusu kasları ve organları yerinde tutar.
